value.syntax: # [doc = " One rule: `rule = typename [genericparm] S assignt S type`"] # [doc = " or `groupname [genericparm] S assigng S grpent`."] # [derive (Clone , Debug)] pub (crate) struct Rule { # [doc = " The type name or group name being defined."] pub (crate) name : Name , # [doc = " `genericparm`, when the rule is generic."] pub (crate) params : Option < GenericParams > , # [doc = " Which assignment operator was written."] pub (crate) assign : Assign , # [doc = " What the rule assigns."] pub (crate) body : RuleBody , # [doc = " The whole rule."] pub (crate) span : Span , }
